proof_body:
by
  intro n
  have key : ∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin n → Fin 6 => ∀ i, f i ∈ S)).card = S.card ^ n := by
    intro S
    have : Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin n → Fin 6 => ∀ i, f i ∈ S) = Fintype.piFinset (fun _ => S) := by
      ext f; simp [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
    rw [this, Fintype.card_piFinset]
    simp
  have h2 : ∀ x : Fin 6, ¬ 2 ∣ (x : ℕ) + 1 ↔ x ∈ ({0, 2, 4} : Finset (Fin 6)) := by decide
  have h3 : ∀ x : Fin 6, ¬ 3 ∣ (x : ℕ) + 1 ↔ x ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 6)) := by decide
  have hdiv : ∀ f : Fin n → Fin 6, ¬ (6 ∣ ∏ i, ((f i : ℕ) + 1)) ↔
      (∀ i, f i ∈ ({0, 2, 4} : Finset (Fin 6))) ∨ (∀ i, f i ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 6))) := by
    intro f
    have e6 : 6 ∣ ∏ i, ((f i : ℕ) + 1) ↔ 2 ∣ ∏ i, ((f i : ℕ) + 1) ∧ 3 ∣ ∏ i, ((f i : ℕ) + 1) := by
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨dvd_trans (by norm_num) h, dvd_trans (by norm_num) h⟩
      · rintro ⟨a, b⟩
        exact (by norm_num : Nat.Coprime 2 3).mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd a b
    rw [e6, Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff Nat.prime_two.prime, Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff Nat.prime_three.prime]
    simp only [← h2, ← h3]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [not_and_or, not_exists, not_exists]
  have hA := key {0, 2, 4}
  have hB := key {0, 1, 3, 4}
  have hAB := key {0, 4}
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin n → Fin 6 => (∀ i, f i ∈ ({0, 2, 4} : Finset (Fin 6))) ∧ (∀ i, f i ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 6))))) = (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin n → Fin 6 => ∀ i, f i ∈ ({0, 4} : Finset (Fin 6)))) := by
    ext f
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, ← forall_and]
    apply forall_congr'
    intro i
    generalize f i = x
    revert x
    decide
  have hun := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin n → Fin 6 => ∀ i, f i ∈ ({0, 2, 4} : Finset (Fin 6)))) (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin n → Fin 6 => ∀ i, f i ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 6))))
  rw [← Finset.filter_or, ← Finset.filter_and, hcard, hA, hB, hAB] at hun
  have hcomp := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Fin 6))) (fun f => 6 ∣ ∏ i, ((f i : ℕ) + 1))
  have hne : Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin n → Fin 6 => ¬ 6 ∣ ∏ i, ((f i : ℕ) + 1)) = Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin n → Fin 6 => (∀ i, f i ∈ ({0, 2, 4} : Finset (Fin 6))) ∨ (∀ i, f i ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 6)))) := by
    ext f
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact hdiv f
  rw [hne] at hcomp
  have hc1 : Fintype.card (Fin n → Fin 6) = 6 ^ n := by simp
  rw [Finset.card_univ, hc1] at hcomp
  have c3 : ({0, 2, 4} : Finset (Fin 6)).card = 3 := by decide
  have c4 : ({0, 1, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 6)).card = 4 := by decide
  have c2 : ({0, 4} : Finset (Fin 6)).card = 2 := by decide
  rw [c3, c4, c2] at hun
  omega
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin n → Fin 6 => 6 ∣ ∏ i, ((f i : ℕ) + 1))).card + 4 ^ n + 3 ^ n = 6 ^ n + 2 ^ n
